title: Honor the one through whom you arrived
summary: This meets the casual contempt that speaks lightly of women while depending on them for everything. The line breaks that contempt by tracing life, love, and kingship through woman.
takeaway: Do not insult the source of your own arrival.
lifeApplication: Before repeating the joke, dismissal, or casual slight, stop at the mouth. Remember whose body carried every family line you honor.

source.shortMeaning: The one through whom life arrives cannot be spoken of with contempt.
source.lifeApplication: Before speaking of women lightly, remember that every lineage passes through them.
